unit: Geometry · Chapter 4. Sides and angles of a triangle
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Theorem: each side of a triangle is less than the sum of the other two: AB < AC + CB.
stages.headlineEnglish: Theorem: each side of a triangle is less than the sum of the other two: AB < AC + CB.

stages.headline: Consequence: for any points A, B, C, AB ≤ AC + CB, with equality when C lies on segment AB.
stages.headlineEnglish: Consequence: for any points A, B, C, AB ≤ AC + CB, with equality when C lies on segment AB.

stages.headline: For the third side: it is more than the difference and less than the sum of the other two.
stages.headlineEnglish: For the third side: it is more than the difference and less than the sum of the other two.
